body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one unattended object within 8 units. Manipulate it as though you were adjacent to it.

surges.html: Imprint the manipulated object. The next creature to interact with it before your next turn becomes Exposed.
Your next Reaction before your next turn may commit 1 fewer die, minimum 2.

rider.title: PROJECTION — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, you may manipulate a second unattended object within 2 units of the first.
